entry.title: Garnet v0.5.0
entry.summary: v0.5.0 — Linux .deb/.rpm packages, macOS Apple-Silicon and Intel CLI tarballs, host-native VSIX release assets, and SHA256SUMS. Research-grade prototype, not production-complete; Apple notarization, Windows MSI, Marketplace/OpenVSX, and Windows/Linux Studio runtime proof remain separate gates.

entry.title: Garnet v0.4.2
